company.name: SnapEDA
company.shortDescription: SnapEDA provides an online library of electronic component CAD models and design resources for engineers and designers.
company.description: SnapEDA is on a mission to help engineers design electronics faster by removing barriers. Over 1 million professionals worldwide rely on SnapEDA to bring their products to life faster.

productsAndServices.description: A platform providing access to millions of free PCB footprints and schematic symbols for electronic components, compatible with various PCB design tools.
productsAndServices.name: SnapMagic Search

productsAndServices.description: A service where users can request creation of PCB footprints or schematic symbols not found in the library, fulfilled by SnapEDA engineers or via an automated tool.
productsAndServices.name: Component Request Service

productsAndServices.description: A patented technology that performs real-time automated checks on PCB footprints to assess manufacturability and prevent design errors.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Footprint Verification
